instruction: Recursively copy all image files (both .jpg and .png) from the 'photos' directory into the 'cpjpg' directory on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened terminal via right-click context menu, used 'find' command to recursively copy all .jpg files from photos/ to cpjpg/, verified with ls -la. Completed in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal from desktop, use find command with -exec, navigate file system, copy files recursively
metadata.task_rationale: Extends original task to include all image types (.jpg and .png), requiring the agent to handle multiple file extensions. Tests ability to generalize the find command pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires copying both .jpg and .png files recursively from photos/ to cpjpg/. Custom metric check_all_images_copied provides partial credit (0.2 per file). All 5 image files must appear in cpjpg. [Fixed: removed nested flatten_files function to avoid validator false positive]

scoring_breakdown.per_file: 0.2 per image file found in cpjpg (5 files total)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter list_directory correctly targets /home/user/Desktop/cpjpg to extract the directory tree of the copy destination
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('expected_files') since get_rule returns the rules dict
Stack-based flattening logic correctly traverses the directory tree dict, collecting filenames from non-dict values and recursing into dict values (subdirectories)
All 5 image files (4 .jpg + 1 .png) from the setup config are listed in expected_files, providing complete coverage of the instruction requirements
Partial credit scoring (0.2 per file) is reasonable for a 5-file copy task
No postconfig needed since file system state persists without UI dependency
Minor: evaluator does not verify original files still exist in photos/ (confirming copy vs move), but this is a minor concern since the instruction clearly says 'copy'

fix_history: Fix 1: Removed nested 'flatten_files' function definition from metric file to avoid validator falsely detecting it as a metric function missing MD5 hash suffix. Replaced with inline stack-based iteration.
